BurnedTowerB1FEusineText:
EUSINE: I dug a
hole here, too…

I was shocked!

SUICUNE raced by
like a blur, right

in front of my
eyes!

For ten years I
chased SUICUNE,

and I finally got
to see it.

I'm all choked up!

{PLAYER}, I owe
this all to you!

Thank you!

I heard that the
legendary #MON

of ECRUTEAK test
chosen humans by

allowing them to
get close.

I'm going to track
SUICUNE.

{PLAYER}, let's
meet again!

Farewell!
